title: Review Request Caps by Fare, Wayfare Rides
content:
The cap on a wrong drop-off review request on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follows the fare charge amount of the trip, as booked.

**Rule.** A fare charge of at least the premium review fare of $100.00 takes the premium review request cap of $60.00; a fare charge of at least the mid review fare of $40.00 but below $100.00 takes the mid review request cap of $35.00; for any smaller fare charge the review request cap is not raised by fare size.

| Fare charge amount | Review request cap |
|---|---|
| $100.00 or more | $60.00 |
| at least $40.00, below $100.00 | $35.00 |
| below $40.00 | not raised |

## Either side of each threshold (hypothetical fare charges)

| Fare charge | Cap |
|---|---|
| $39.99 | not raised |
| $40.00 | $35.00 |
| $99.99 | $35.00 |
| $100.00 | $60.00 |

The threshold is read against the fare charge amount itself, before any fare adjustment booked on the trip.
